Netflix v3 combines ten fiscal years of sourced history with a content-cash operating model. Independent review approves dated research and restricted conditional allocations only. Bear, base and bull have no assigned probabilities.

The first forecast period is H2 2026: full-year assumptions less pinned H1 actuals. FY2027 growth compares full FY2026, not the half-year stub. Nine full years follow, through 2035; terminal year is 2036.

GAAP-like EBIT retains compensation, operating leases and content amortization. Termination fees and interest income are excluded. Existing-award expense is removed only in the separately selected allocation, after tax, before those awards are valued.

FCFF = NOPAT + content amortization − cash content spending + noncontent D&A − PPE capex − noncontent working-capital investment. Content liabilities, commitments and operating leases are not deducted again as debt. Known next-12-month content obligations of $11,939.734m must fit the selected H2/FY2027 payment timing.

Annual editing preserves source content-amortization, PPE, noncontent D&A and working-capital assumptions. The net-investment input solves residual content cash spending, subject to the reviewed cash/amortization bounds and commitment coverage. H2 fixed dollar components remain fixed; later components scale with edited revenue.

USD WACC and operating paths are analyst assumptions. Unequal edited annual WACCs compound over exact 365.25-day intervals; a constant path reproduces the reviewed June discounting. Claims and award-expense PV use the same dated discount factors; the debt-PV diagnostic beyond 2035 extends the final explicit annual WACC.

Annual funding is a capacity proxy, not bank cash or intrayear solvency. It retains required cash, debt principal, assumed 4.9% after-tax interest and separate settlements. No buybacks, dividends, acquisitions or refinancing are assumed in that funding scenario.

Cash tax applies to positive operating EBIT. Brazil’s $729m H1 payment is already in June cash and is never reserved or paid again; additional Brazil exposure remains a separate assumption. No recovery asset is assumed.

Terminal investment is the larger of the content-cash component requirement and NOPAT × growth / incremental ROIC. They are not added together. Terminal content, noncontent D&A and ongoing compensation remain; no existing-award expense is added back in terminal value.

June allocation is unselected by default. Choose the restricted illustration or supply every economic input. Face debt $14,372m and the separate $13.574m financing-rate derivative claim are matched. Financing FX reserve is an assumption, not gross derivatives or notional. Hedges hypothetically close on July 1 and settle in H2; later funding assumes unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX. Weighted-strike/life options and the PSU multiplier are approximations, not legal maximum entitlements.

The award-expense schedule must equal the chosen total, fit its recognition horizon no later than June 30, 2029, and preserve amortization, D&A, future compensation and positive other cash costs. The $150.25470453m source-context envelope applies only under no unmodeled positive cost additions. It is not verified June expense or a legal ceiling. Future compensation retains at least FY2025 SBC/revenue. These retained costs already sit in EBIT and are not charged twice.

The optional post-June capital ledger pairs July $1,000m note principal with $988.55m proceeds before other expenses. An intended November repayment is not an observed October repayment. All other movements start unknown. A complete ledger does not roll operating EV forward and never produces a current target.

2016–2025 history is source-linked. DVD operations remain through their 2023 closure; pre-2019 lease balances are not comparable. Historical content cash is derived from additions and liability changes. CFO less PPE is not unlevered FCFF and can differ from issuer FCF. Exact 2025 membership/ARM and the 2016 later-format regional mix remain missing. Share fields use the 2025 split basis.

Run simulation is manual. Defaults are fixed, with no calibrated probability claim. Trials expose dated operating EV only; neither June common-share allocations nor the post-June capital ledger are sampled. Invalid content bounds, commitment coverage or amortization exceeding total operating costs withhold a trial.

common.unit: USD millions; shares millions; percentages as decimal fractions
common.terminal_method: max(component-based net reinvestment, terminal NOPAT * g / incremental ROIC). Never add both. Terminal includes tax and ongoing content maintenance.

operating_policy.future_sbc: Core GAAP-like EBIT includes compensation cost. Allocation requires an explicit expense schedule for existing June unvested awards already included in that EBIT and removes only that schedule after tax before valuing those existing awards separately. Future-grant cash replacement excludes the removed existing-award expense. No broad SBC addback; no terminal existing-award addback. Allocation additionally enforces the remaining-expense total and recognition horizon, source-context admission limit under the no-positive-additions convention, and explicit retained compensation/other-cash-cost envelopes.
operating_policy.leases: Remain operating: expense retained in EBIT, no lease-debt subtraction and no ROU depreciation addback.
operating_policy.content: Cash spending includes additions and liability settlement; opening content liabilities and unrecognized content commitments are not deducted again as debt.
operating_policy.acquisitions: Future acquisition cash spending explicitly assumed 0; organic forecast, existing acquired assets embedded. H1 2026 acquisition already in June cash.
operating_policy.nonoperating_items: Termination fee and interest income excluded by beginning at operating EBIT; fee cash already in June cash and never added again.
operating_policy.tax_incentives: Content spending is net of incentives as represented by the filing cash-flow presentation; no extra incentive asset added to equity.
operating_policy.working_capital: Noncontent incremental operating investment assumption includes ordinary operating assets/liabilities and incentive timing. Excludes cash, debt, content assets/liabilities and separate claims.

assumption_basis.2026_base: Revenue midpoint and 31.5% margin match July 16 guidance; amortization, capex, D&A, taxes and working capital are separate analyst estimates. Full year cash content / amortization 1.1x matches management indication.
assumption_basis.long_term: Revenue decelerates to mature growth; margin ranges reflect uncertain scale and reinvestment. These paths are not issuer guidance or measured probabilities.
assumption_basis.discount_rate: 8%/9%/10.5% subjective nominal-USD required-return scenarios, not observed current WACC, CAPM regression or a verified market discount rate.
assumption_basis.tax: 18%/21%/25% analyst cash-tax assumptions acknowledge uncertain SBC benefits, domestic deductions, foreign taxes and tax incentive timing; no perpetual extrapolation of 2025 13.7% book tax rate.
assumption_basis.content: Explicitly model amortization and cash spend; do not add back content amortization without matching reinvestment. Terminal ROIC floor protects against free perpetual growth.

claims_scope.treatment: Rounded face value selected only in illustrative policy; fair value and carrying value shown separately. Liability model excludes operating leases and content obligations already represented in operating cash flow.

All 123.891603m June options vested and exercisable. Existing claim modeled separately; weighted-strike Black-Scholes approximation is analyst optionality proxy, not exact grant-level appraisal. June remaining life and volatility are assumed, not silently borrowed as exact facts.

2.012512m aggregate unvested awards is not proven maximum payout. Allocation removes an explicitly assumed remaining-expense schedule for these same awards from modeled EBIT after tax, then values the units separately; future-grant compensation remains charged. FY2025 unrecognized compensation cost was $47m over 1.53 years; that is not a verified June remaining balance. Policy must select explicit multiplier or replace units; example uses 2x; multiplier is editable. Weighted EPS shares are never equity denominator.

FY2025 gross unrecognized benefits $566m, of which $409m classified noncurrent, are stale at June. June precise reserve is unverified. Policy requires chosen income-tax reserve and cash settlement. No 2025 number silently treated as current.

FY2025 $619m expense and anticipated approximately $700m deposits are superseded for cash status by the June filing: $729m of prior-period non-income-tax assessment payments were made in H1 and are already reflected in June cash. Do not deduct or settle that paid item again. No recovery asset is recognized here. The separate policy input covers only additional exposure beyond those paid amounts; its value is unknown unless explicitly assumed.

Operating cash-flow FX hedges stay in revenue/cost forecasts. Financing interest-rate derivatives have a sourced $13.574m net liability, separately reserved because the selected $14,372m face principal excludes derivatives. Do not also subtract the approximately $14m debt carrying-basis adjustment. Financing FX fair-value hedges have $2,934.991m notional, but their net fair value is not separately disclosed from operating designated FX contracts. Require a separately labeled nonnegative analyst reserve for financing FX; illustration assumes $100m, not a reported claim. Neither gross derivatives nor hedge notional is deducted. Hypothetical July 1 closeout and constant June FX underpin the funding illustration, not actual events.

claims_scope.treatment: No complete fair-value appraisal. Additional-claim input must be deliberately chosen; null never zero.

policyExample.policy_label: ILLUSTRATIVE June allocation, analyst choices; not default or current target
policyExample.basis: $566m stale FY2025 gross tax-benefit amount is an explicit analyst income-tax reserve, plus $250m other claims. Additional Brazil exposure beyond the $729m already paid in H1 is deliberately assumed zero, not verified absent; the paid item is never reserved or settled twice and no recovery is credited. Face principal $14,372m excludes derivative fair values. Separately reserve the reported $13.574m interest-rate derivative net liability and assume $100m financing FX net liability because its exact fair value is not separately disclosed. No gross derivative, notional or debt carrying-basis deduction. Assume financing hedges close out July 1 at those values; total $929.574m separate cash settles in H2. Funding thereafter uses unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX assumptions. Existing-award expense embedded in EBIT is assumed $25m H2 2026, $25m 2027 and $10m 2028, zero thereafter; remove only its after-tax cost before separately allocating existing awards. This $60m is an explicitly reconciled remaining-expense assumption, not June reported unrecognized compensation. Its whole schedule must fit the selected December 2028 horizon, never beyond June 2029 under the supported three-year convention. Under the assumed absence of unmodeled positive modifications or other additions, the policy restricts total expense to the $47m plus 1.245383m x $82.91 = approximately $150.2547m source-context envelope. This is an analytical admission limit, not a verified June or legal ceiling. Retain 1.1% of each period revenue for future-grant cash-replacement compensation and 20% for other cash costs, already embedded in EBIT and never subtracted again. Future-grant compensation excludes the removed existing expense and cannot be below the explicit policy reference of FY2025 SBC/revenue. Cost components must fit jointly after content amortization and noncontent D&A. 2x award units is a sensitivity, not a legal maximum. Operating liquidity reserve $3bn is an assumption.

scope.zh-Hans: 资本及折现起点为 2026 年六月三十日；信息截至十月十九日。定于十月二十日公布的第三季度业绩尚待发布，未纳入。默认普通股分配及当前目标价未知。选定的六月分配仅为条件示例，并非当前目标价。

summary.en: Netflix v3 combines ten fiscal years of sourced history with a content-cash operating model. Independent review approves dated research and restricted conditional allocations only. Bear, base and bull have no assigned probabilities.
summary.zh-Hans: 奈飞 v3 将十年来源历史与内容现金经营模型结合。独立复核仅认可指定日期研究及受限条件分配。熊市、基准及牛市情景未赋予概率。

growth.en: The first forecast period is H2 2026: full-year assumptions less pinned H1 actuals. FY2027 growth compares full FY2026, not the half-year stub. Nine full years follow, through 2035; terminal year is 2036.
growth.zh-Hans: 首个预测期为 2026 下半年：全年假设减去固定上半年实际数。2027 年增长比较 2026 全年，而非半年片段。随后为九个完整年度至 2035 年，终值年度为 2036 年。

profitability.en: GAAP-like EBIT retains compensation, operating leases and content amortization. Termination fees and interest income are excluded. Existing-award expense is removed only in the separately selected allocation, after tax, before those awards are valued.
profitability.zh-Hans: 类美国准则营业利润保留薪酬、经营租赁及内容摊销。终止费和利息收入不纳入。仅在单独选定分配中，先税后移除现有奖励费用，再计量该奖励。

capital.en: FCFF = NOPAT + content amortization − cash content spending + noncontent D&A − PPE capex − noncontent working-capital investment. Content liabilities, commitments and operating leases are not deducted again as debt. Known next-12-month content obligations of $11,939.734m must fit the selected H2/FY2027 payment timing.
capital.zh-Hans: 自由现金流等于税后营业利润加内容摊销、减内容现金支出、加非内容折旧摊销、减固定资产开支及非内容营运资本投资。内容负债、承诺与经营租赁不重复当作债务扣除。未来十二个月已知内容义务 119.39734 亿美元必须符合选定下半年及 2027 年支付时间。

mapping.en: Annual editing preserves source content-amortization, PPE, noncontent D&A and working-capital assumptions. The net-investment input solves residual content cash spending, subject to the reviewed cash/amortization bounds and commitment coverage. H2 fixed dollar components remain fixed; later components scale with edited revenue.
mapping.zh-Hans: 年度编辑保留来源内容摊销、固定资产、非内容折旧摊销及营运资本假设。净投资输入反推剩余内容现金支出，并遵守已复核现金／摊销范围及承诺覆盖约束。下半年固定金额不变，后续分项随编辑收入变化。

wacc.en: USD WACC and operating paths are analyst assumptions. Unequal edited annual WACCs compound over exact 365.25-day intervals; a constant path reproduces the reviewed June discounting. Claims and award-expense PV use the same dated discount factors; the debt-PV diagnostic beyond 2035 extends the final explicit annual WACC.
wacc.zh-Hans: 美元资本成本与经营路径均为分析假设。不同年度资本成本按实际天数除以 365.25 复利折现；固定路径重现已复核六月折现。请求权及奖励费用现值使用同一日期折现因子；2035 年后的债务现值诊断沿用最后一个明确年度资本成本。

funding.en: Annual funding is a capacity proxy, not bank cash or intrayear solvency. It retains required cash, debt principal, assumed 4.9% after-tax interest and separate settlements. No buybacks, dividends, acquisitions or refinancing are assumed in that funding scenario.
funding.zh-Hans: 年度资金仅为能力代理，并非银行现金或年内偿付证明。保留所需现金、债务本金、假设 4.9% 税后利息及单独结算。该资金情景假设无回购、股息、收购或再融资。

tax.en: Cash tax applies to positive operating EBIT. Brazil’s $729m H1 payment is already in June cash and is never reserved or paid again; additional Brazil exposure remains a separate assumption. No recovery asset is assumed.
tax.zh-Hans: 现金税适用于正营业利润。巴西上半年已支付 7.29 亿美元已体现在六月现金，绝不重复拨备或支付。额外巴西风险单独假设，不假设回收资产。

terminal.en: Terminal investment is the larger of the content-cash component requirement and NOPAT × growth / incremental ROIC. They are not added together. Terminal content, noncontent D&A and ongoing compensation remain; no existing-award expense is added back in terminal value.
terminal.zh-Hans: 终值投资取内容现金分项要求与税后营业利润乘增长率除增量 ROIC 中较大者，不将两者相加。终值保留内容、非内容折旧摊销及持续薪酬，不加回现有奖励费用。

claims.en: June allocation is unselected by default. Choose the restricted illustration or supply every economic input. Face debt $14,372m and the separate $13.574m financing-rate derivative claim are matched. Financing FX reserve is an assumption, not gross derivatives or notional. Hedges hypothetically close on July 1 and settle in H2; later funding assumes unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX. Weighted-strike/life options and the PSU multiplier are approximations, not legal maximum entitlements.
claims.zh-Hans: 六月分配默认未选择。请选择受限示例或填写全部经济输入。债务面值 143.72 亿美元与单独利率融资衍生品请求权 1357.4 万美元配对。融资外汇拨备为假设，并非衍生品总额或名义本金。假设对冲于七月一日平仓并于下半年结算；随后资金假设无对冲利息 4.9% 及固定六月汇率。加权执行价／期限期权及 PSU 倍数仅为近似，并非法定最高权利。

awards.en: The award-expense schedule must equal the chosen total, fit its recognition horizon no later than June 30, 2029, and preserve amortization, D&A, future compensation and positive other cash costs. The $150.25470453m source-context envelope applies only under no unmodeled positive cost additions. It is not verified June expense or a legal ceiling. Future compensation retains at least FY2025 SBC/revenue. These retained costs already sit in EBIT and are not charged twice.
awards.zh-Hans: 奖励费用表必须等于选定总额，符合不迟于 2029 年六月三十日的确认期限，并保留摊销、折旧、未来薪酬及正的其他现金费用。1.5025470453 亿美元来源背景范围仅适用于无未建模正向费用增加的假设，并非已核实六月费用或法律上限。未来薪酬至少保留 2025 股份薪酬／收入比。这些成本已包含在营业利润，不重复扣除。

financing.en: The optional post-June capital ledger pairs July $1,000m note principal with $988.55m proceeds before other expenses. An intended November repayment is not an observed October repayment. All other movements start unknown. A complete ledger does not roll operating EV forward and never produces a current target.
financing.zh-Hans: 可选六月后资本台账将七月 10 亿美元票据本金与其他费用前 9.8855 亿美元收入配对。拟于十一月偿债不等于十月已偿还。其他变化初始均未知。完整台账不将经营价值滚动至当前，也不生成当前目标价。

history.en: 2016–2025 history is source-linked. DVD operations remain through their 2023 closure; pre-2019 lease balances are not comparable. Historical content cash is derived from additions and liability changes. CFO less PPE is not unlevered FCFF and can differ from issuer FCF. Exact 2025 membership/ARM and the 2016 later-format regional mix remain missing. Share fields use the 2025 split basis.
history.zh-Hans: 2016–2025 历史均关联来源。DVD 业务保留至 2023 停止运营，2019 年前租赁余额不可比。历史内容现金由新增资产与负债变动推导。经营现金流减固定资产开支并非无杠杆自由现金流，可能不同于公司公布自由现金流。2025 精确会员／会员均收入及 2016 后期格式区域占比仍缺失。股数按 2025 拆股基础调整。

uncertainty.en: Run simulation is manual. Defaults are fixed, with no calibrated probability claim. Trials expose dated operating EV only; neither June common-share allocations nor the post-June capital ledger are sampled. Invalid content bounds, commitment coverage or amortization exceeding total operating costs withhold a trial.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 模拟需手动运行。默认输入固定，不声称经过概率校准。试验仅提供指定日期经营企业价值，不抽样六月每股分配或六月后资本台账。内容范围、承诺覆盖无效或摊销超过经营总成本时不输出该试验。

auditResults.note: Frozen readiness file remains unchanged; separate review closes dated research gate only. JS integration requires separate review.
